name: plusprayer-functions
description: +Prayer Cloud Functions (assembly, prayer reactions, presence, admin callables).

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only dataconnect --project demo-plusprayer '"$npm_node_execpath" --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.ts'
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-plusprayer '"$npm_node_execpath" --import tsx --test test/rules/*.test.ts'
scripts.emulators:sweeper: env -u GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS DATA_CONNECT_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9399 FIREBASE_DATABASE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9000 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-plusprayer node --import tsx scripts/emulator-sweeper.ts
scripts.seed:emulator: env -u GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS DATA_CONNECT_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9399 FIREBASE_DATABASE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9000 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-plusprayer node --import tsx scripts/seed-emulator.ts
